_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'ACTIVITY ATTRIBUTES' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.03.03.

f01_Activity_Code_and_Title.label: Activity Code and Title
f01_Activity_Code_and_Title.guidance: Unique identifier code and full descriptive title of the schedule activity.

f02_Activity_Description_and_Scope_Summa.label: Activity Description and Scope Summary
f02_Activity_Description_and_Scope_Summa.guidance: Detailed technical narrative of the specific scope executed under this activity.

f03_Assigned_Work_Package_Reference.label: Assigned Work Package Reference
f03_Assigned_Work_Package_Reference.guidance: Corresponding parent WBS code and deliverable component mapping.

f04_Predecessor_Activities_and_Logic.label: Predecessor Activities and Logic
f04_Predecessor_Activities_and_Logic.guidance: List of preceding activities with dependency relationships (FS, SS, FF, SF) and lead/lag times.

f05_Successor_Activities_and_Logic.label: Successor Activities and Logic
f05_Successor_Activities_and_Logic.guidance: List of succeeding activities dependent upon the completion or start of this activity.

f06_Required_Team_Roles_and_Headcount.label: Required Team Roles and Headcount
f06_Required_Team_Roles_and_Headcount.guidance: Specific staffing roles, technical disciplines, and quantity of resources required.

f07_Technical_Skills_and_Equipment_Neede.label: Technical Skills and Equipment Needed
f07_Technical_Skills_and_Equipment_Neede.guidance: Specialized skill sets, machinery, software licenses, or facilities required for performance.

f08_Imposed_Start_and_Finish_Dates.label: Imposed Start and Finish Dates
f08_Imposed_Start_and_Finish_Dates.guidance: Contractual or management-mandated fixed start/finish constraint dates.

f09_Activity_Assumptions_and_Location_Co.label: Activity Assumptions and Location Constraints
f09_Activity_Assumptions_and_Location_Co.guidance: Critical assumptions regarding execution conditions, performance location, and physical constraints.
